purpose: Eight dated 2026/27 complete home kit component references. An SWOS palette code is a simplification, not faithful kit recreation.

entries.sourceClassification: club launch describing standard home pairing + official club merchandise
entries.notes: 2026/27 standard home strip is red shirt, white shorts, black socks. Club shop also sells black shorts and white socks as alternatives; this is the launch pairing. Trim and collar design are not reproducible in SWOS.

entries.sourceClassification: 2026/27 kit release with official club shop corroboration
entries.notes: Everton 2026/27 royal-blue shirt is paired with white shorts and royal-blue socks with white and amber detail. SWOS blue represents the dominant sock colour and omits turnover trim.
AFC Bournemouth official 2026/27 club store names black men's home shorts and black adult home socks. Red/black shirt stripes remain a SWOS approximation.

entries.sourceClassification: club 2026/27 home-kit launch and matching products
entries.notes: Leeds United's official 2026/27 home-kit description explicitly pairs the white shirt with classic white shorts and socks. The fine blue/yellow horizontal pinstripes cannot be reproduced accurately in SWOS.

entries.sourceClassification: dated 2026/27 full-kit coverage and club store 26/27 collection
entries.notes: 2026/27 Sunderland red/white striped shirt paired with black shorts and black socks bearing a wide red band. This is season-specific; older 25/26 red-sock references must not be substituted.

entries.sourceClassification: club store individually lists Royal Blue 26/27 shorts and Royal Blue & White 26/27 socks
entries.notes: Brighton 2026/27 official kit has royal-blue shorts and predominantly royal-blue socks with white edging. Fine white pinstripes on the shirt are omitted in SWOS; primary sock colour mapped to Blue.

entries.sourceClassification: 2026/27 kit manufacturer states white shorts and white socks
entries.notes: Crystal Palace's 2026/27 Eagle Sash white-based home kit has white shorts and socks. SWOS lacks a diagonal sash shirt pattern; white is an explicit approximation, not a reproduction.

entries.sourceClassification: dated 2026/27 full-kit release and club store socks page
entries.notes: Burnley 2026/27 men's standard home kit pairs white shorts with claret socks carrying sky-blue hoops; SWOS Brown/claret represents the main sock colour and cannot render fine hoops.
